Usage: ffmpeg [options] -i infile outfile
Global options:
-y                  Replace existing output
-loglevel loglevel  Select logging verbosity
-max_error_rate maximum error rate  Set the tolerated decoding error ratio
Per-file options:
-i input_file       Read an input file
-f fmt              Select a format
-c codec            Select a codec
-map_metadata outfile[,metadata]:infile[,metadata]  Copy selected metadata
-metadata string=string  Set metadata
-t duration         Set duration
-c:v codec          Select a video codec with a stream specifier
